scope: Candidates not retained as Arizona custom/luxury builder or design-build outreach records because the accessible public evidence did not meet the requested official-current-work standard.

rejectedCompanies.reasonRejected: The public site identifies itself as a platform/local expert for new-construction properties, lots, and sales consultation rather than as a builder or design-build firm. It is a referral/listing resource, not a comparable contractor target.

A current renovation completion result was located through a PR distribution source, but no verified official-company domain/current project page was established during this pass. It was excluded rather than relying on third-party-only evidence.

The official site describes custom-home and renovation services, but the reviewed public result did not show a specific live project, available home/community, hiring/expansion event, or equally specific current-work trigger. Generic service copy alone was not used here.
